lines.t: I ran so far from every holy thing
Chasing all the answers that the world would bring
But every road I took just left me more undone
Till Your gentle voice said, “Daughter, you can come”
You saw my shame, You saw my fear
You didn’t turn Your face, You drew me near
In all my failures, in all my scars
You wrapped forgiveness ’round my heart
YahuShua, Your love keeps running after me
Through every desert, every doubt, You never leave
You break the chains and call my spirit free
Your mercy is a river with no end I see
YahuShua, You rewrite my history
With never ending love and mercy
I hear the accusations in the dead of night
But Your word rises up and brings them into light
You say I’m chosen, I am washed and new
Not by what I’ve done but what You’ve done in truth
When I am weak and I can’t stand
You lift me up with nail‑scarred hands
You turn my mourning into praise
You pour out grace I can’t repay
YahuShua, Your love keeps running after me
Through every desert, every doubt, You never leave
You break the chains and call my spirit free
Your mercy is a river with no end I see
YahuShua, You rewrite my history
With never ending love and mercy
No height, no depth, no darkness I have known
Can pull me from the safety of Your throne
You leave the ninety‑nine to find my soul
Your heart for me is making broken whole
Love that never ends, mercy every day
You pick up all the pieces that I threw away
Love that never ends, mercy like the sea
Flowing from Your heart and washing over me
YahuShua, Your love keeps running after me
Through every desert, every doubt, You never leave
You break the chains and call my spirit free
Your mercy is a river with no end I see
YahuShua, You rewrite my history
With never ending love and mercy
Never ending love, never ending mercy
YahuShua, You are worthy
Never ending love, never ending mercy
YahuShua, You are worthy
